releases.notes:
## Improvements

- In singleplayer worlds, the fullscreen map now fills unexplored areas with real terrain read from the world's own saved region files instead of showing only predictions, so a fresh world immediately shows its actual landscape. This scanned terrain overrides predicted and imported data but never replaces live captured or synchronized data, and the new "Load Map From Saved Chunks" toggle in the fullscreen map settings turns it off. ([PR #150](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/150))
- Scanning saved chunks during map view no longer leaves partially covered regions stuck in an endless re-scan loop, no longer spams file write errors while the map saves in the background, and no longer causes stutter or multi-second black patches when zooming the fullscreen map.
- Opening or panning the fullscreen map over areas that were already cached no longer lags for several seconds; those regions are now decoded much faster and their tiles update progressively instead of all waiting for the whole batch.

## Fixes

- On Minecraft 1.17 to 1.19, slider handles in screens with UI transitions now fade along with the rest of the interface instead of staying fully opaque, and integer sliders no longer draw only half of the handle. ([Issue #151](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/issues/151))
- Switching the search screen to structure mode no longer silently re-enables structure icons and saves that change; the setting is now only turned on when you actually locate a structure, and biome searches leave it untouched.
- Biome and structure searches now start from your current position when you are in the searched dimension, instead of around the previous search result, while the center fields remain editable by hand.
- Biome searches on tall terrain no longer report a far-away location as the nearest match; searching now proceeds outward in expanding rings, so a larger search radius never returns a farther result than a smaller one.

---

## 改进

- 在单人世界中，全屏地图现在会从该世界自身的存档区域文件读取真实地形来填充未探索区域，而不只是显示预测，因此新世界能立即显示真实地貌。这些扫描地形会覆盖预测与导入的数据，但绝不会替换实时捕获或同步的数据；全屏地图设置中新增的“从已保存的区块加载地图”开关可关闭该功能。 ([PR #150](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/150))
- 浏览地图时扫描已保存的区块不再让部分覆盖的区域陷入无休止的重复扫描，不再在地图后台保存时刷出大量文件写入错误，也不再导致缩放全屏地图时卡顿或出现持续数秒的黑色区块。
- 在已缓存过的区域上打开或平移全屏地图不再卡顿数秒；这些区域现在解码快得多，且地图区块会逐步刷新，而不是全部等待整批解码完成。

## 修复

- 在 Minecraft 1.17 至 1.19 上，启用界面过渡动效时，界面中的滑块把手现在会随界面其余部分一起淡入淡出，而不再保持完全不透明；整数滑块也不再只绘制一半的把手。 ([Issue #151](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/issues/151))
- 将搜索界面切换到结构模式不再悄悄重新开启结构图标并保存该改动；现在只有在真正定位结构时才会开启该设置，生物群系搜索不会改动它。
- 生物群系与结构搜索现在以你当前所在位置为起点（前提是你处于所搜索的维度中），而不再围绕上一次的搜索结果进行搜索；中心坐标输入框仍可手动编辑。
- 在高耸地形上进行生物群系搜索不再把远处的位置报告为最近匹配；搜索现在按不断扩大的同心环向外推进，因此更大的搜索半径不会再返回比更小半径更远的结果。


**Full commit history:** [`v0.1.15...v0.1.16`](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/compare/v0.1.15...v0.1.16)

releases.notes:
## Improvements

- Explored void areas and the space around End islands are now drawn in a configurable color instead of looking identical to unexplored space; the default is a dark indigo, and a new Void Color setting can also be turned off to keep the old transparent look. Unexplored areas stay transparent. ([Issue #129](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/issues/129))
- The fullscreen map's drawing tools gain a one-click clear button that removes every drawing in the viewed dimension, and a single undo brings the whole cleared batch back. ([Issue #138](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/issues/138))
- The faint boundary lines on fullscreen map tiles are gone, and the chunk grid keeps its existing toggle while gaining an opacity setting from 0 to 100% (default 25%, matching the previous look). ([Issue #141](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/issues/141))
- The minimap background plate now has a configurable opacity (0-100%, default 50% which is the previous value), so the map stays readable in bright scenes instead of washing out. ([Issue #135](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/issues/135))
- Mod screens now fade and scale in when opened and fade out when closed instead of appearing and vanishing in a single frame; closing back to a parent screen replays that screen's reveal, and ESC or the opening key finishes a closing animation immediately. Settings rows surface top to bottom, switching config tabs fades the old rows out and the new rows in, and the sidebar tool groups (including the drawing grid) fly their buttons out of the group button. A new Interface section in settings can disable the animations or pick a Fast, Standard, or Relaxed speed. ([PR #148](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/148))
- The minimap now fades in and out instead of hard-cutting when the fullscreen map opens, F3 is shown, the HUD is hidden, or a container is opened, and its radar markers and trail dots fade along with it; switching worlds still switches instantly. ([PR #148](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/148))
- Dimension and group dropdowns, the map location menu, target selectors, and the tool-panel group expansion now fade in with a slight slide instead of appearing in one frame, while clicks always respect the popup's actual visibility state. ([PR #148](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/148))
- Servers can now disable the minimap, the fullscreen world map, waypoints, and the prediction underlay individually through new server-side options instead of banning the whole mod. A restricted feature is hidden, its settings rows show a server notice, and the server may supply a short custom message explaining the restriction. ([Issue #147](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/issues/147), [PR #149](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/149))

## Fixes

- Opening the dimension or group dropdown in the waypoint list, or the dimension dropdown on the fullscreen map, no longer lets the waypoint rows and toolbar labels show through the popup on Minecraft 1.20-1.21.5. ([Issue #128](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/issues/128))
- The Xaero color style now draws glass overlays like the Conflux style: stained glass flush with or above the sea surface, and glass on land, are no longer hidden, while only torches remain hidden. Areas already captured keep their old colors until they are revisited. ([Issue #130](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/issues/130))
- The waypoint edit/create form no longer overlaps itself: the color caption, marker-style caption, swatch grid, and validation error no longer collide or hide behind other rows at small interface sizes, all rows share one width, and the Cross-Dimension toggle shows its full label while the Y override field stays in place instead of disappearing.

releases.notes:
## Improvements

- Terrain you previously explored with Xaero's World Map can now be imported into your local map: an import tool on the map screen locates the matching world data, lists the dimensions with their region counts, and merges them in with progress display and cancel. Imported terrain only fills areas Conflux Map has not captured yet, is replaced by live capture when you revisit those areas, and renders in both map color styles. ([PR #143](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/143), [Issue #137](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/issues/137))
- Nether ceiling bedrock is now shaded by the thickness of its column (1 layer brightest, 5 layers darkest), so single-layer breakable spots stand out; a new Show Nether Ceiling Bedrock Thickness toggle in the map style settings turns the shading off for a flat bedrock surface. Breaking through the roof still reveals the terrain below. ([PR #140](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/140), [Issue #133](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/issues/133))
- Item-icon waypoint labels on the HUD now follow the same screen sway as the in-world 3D waypoint labels under nausea, view bobbing and hurt tilt, instead of staying rigid while the world wobbles. ([Issue #134](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/issues/134), [PR #144](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/144))
- Prediction underlay tiles are now reused when you pan back over an area you already viewed, and the Map Quality setting now also sizes how many prediction tiles are kept, from 64 at the performance presets to 1024 at the highest quality. ([PR #142](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/142))
- The farthest zoom levels of the seed-prediction map now resolve biomes once per pixel, which makes them cheaper to build; as a result, rivers narrower than a pixel no longer appear at those zoom levels. ([PR #142](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/142))

## Fixes

- On a server running the companion, entering a nether portal or any respawn that changes dimension no longer adds a bogus "World 1" entry beside the server's own world in the sub-world list; the local profile list stays empty unless you create an entry yourself. ([Issue #136](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/issues/136))
- The Show Layer Label toggle now sits in the Minimap settings section next to Show Coordinates and Show Biome, matching what it actually controls; existing saved configurations keep their current value. ([PR #131](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/131), [Issue #127](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/issues/127))
- Waypoint beams are visible again at normal viewing distances on 1.21.6 through 1.21.8 without any shader pack; every other version behaves as before. ([PR #144](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/144))
- With a deferred shader pack installed, waypoint beams no longer disappear while their labels keep rendering on 1.21.9 through 26.2; the beams are now shaded as part of the scene. ([PR #144](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/144))
- Item-icon waypoint labels and highlighted-player HUD labels are visible again on 1.21.8 and on other 1.19.4-and-later versions, where they had been hidden entirely. ([PR #144](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/144))
- The frame around an item-icon waypoint label no longer flickers or loses sides while the player moves; it stays a complete one-pixel outline in every frame. ([PR #144](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/144))
- Item-icon waypoint labels now move at full screen-pixel precision instead of stepping in 2–3 pixel jumps at automatic GUI scale, so they follow the view smoothly. ([PR #144](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/144))

releases.notes:
## Improvements

- Public waypoints can now be organized into server-held groups: operators (and group creators where policy allows) create, rename, and delete groups, and move waypoints into a group or back to the ungrouped pool from the Public tab's new group filter and actions, the waypoint edit form, or the new /confluxmap waypoints group commands. Deleting a group returns its waypoints to the ungrouped pool, multi-selection moves apply as one all-or-nothing batch, and older clients or servers keep working without group support. ([Issue #119](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/issues/119))
- A new Worker Threads setting sizes the mod's background worker pool from your CPU: Auto (default) uses only performance cores on a hybrid CPU and all logical processors on a regular one, All Threads uses every logical processor, and Custom takes a count you pick (1-32). Changes take effect the next time the game starts. ([Issue #125](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/issues/125))
- Predicted map tiles on Minecraft 1.18 and newer now take roughly half as long to sample (on 1.21.4 a full tile drops from about 926 ms to 297 ms), so large autofill areas appear much sooner. Terrain output on 1.17.1 and earlier is unchanged, and 1.18+ output can shift very slightly. ([PR #126](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/126))
- Predicted tiles in a full-screen area now compose from the viewport center outward, so the terrain you are looking at fills in first instead of waiting behind edge tiles. ([Issue #124](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/issues/124))
- The local waypoint list now groups waypoints under a header per set (set name on the left, member count on the right) with its members indented beneath; clicking a header folds or unfolds the set. Fold state is saved with the world, matches inside folded sets stay visible while a search is active, and cross-world read-only waypoints remain a flat list at the end. ([Issue #120](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/issues/120))
- The long Map and Waypoints settings tabs are now split into labeled sections separated by thin dividers — Layers and Map Style on the Map tab; Teleport, Visibility, Waypoint List, and In-World Rendering on the Waypoints tab — making the options easier to find. ([Issue #121](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/issues/121))
- The fullscreen map now zooms in up to 8x (0.125 blocks per screen pixel), so chunk-level detail stays readable on large displays. Zoom-out levels, the zoom step, and the minimap's zoom are unchanged. ([Issue #123](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/issues/123))
- The Public tab of the waypoint list gained the local tab's list controls: rows group under collapsible headers (ungrouped last), an eye button on each row hides that waypoint from your own view, and hidden rows and folded groups are remembered on your client.

## Fixes

- Areas the server has proven empty — the End beyond the generated islands, cleared generation regions, deleted chunks — now show as empty instead of letting predicted terrain show through.
- On vanilla 1.17.1 and 1.18.2, in-world waypoint beams and labels no longer rotate away from their waypoint, which could leave them misplaced or even off-screen at large camera angles.
- Waypoint labels in the world now shrink more with distance: apparent size falls from full at 12 blocks to 30% at 40 blocks and beyond, instead of stopping at 60% after 20 blocks, so near and far labels are easy to tell apart. Aiming at or selecting a label still shows it at full size.

---

## 改进

- 公共路径点现在可以归入服务器持有的分组：管理员（以及策略允许下的分组创建者）可在「公共」页新增的分组筛选与操作、路径点编辑表单或新的 /confluxmap waypoints group 指令中创建、重命名、删除分组，并把路径点移入分组或移回未分组。删除分组时其路径点会回到未分组；多选移动作为一批整体生效（要么全部成功，要么全部不变）；旧版客户端与服务器不受影响，只是看不到分组。 ([Issue #119](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/issues/119))

releases.notes:
## Improvements

- Fullscreen biome search at large radii is much faster: a 100,000-block-radius search now finishes in about 0.7 seconds for common biomes and 0.3 seconds for rare ones on a six-worker pool, down from several seconds (and longer when the worker ran on an efficiency core). Results keep the same surface-biome semantics.
- Opening the biome view is far faster: biome map tiles no longer solve terrain they never show, cutting the first detail level from around 1.0 second per tile to about 27 ms. Colors on hillsides may now reflect the climate biome instead of the surface biome, matching cubiomes-viewer semantics.
- Paper servers no longer take large tick spikes when many chunks unload while the map is watching them, and keeping the map open no longer adds a steady per-tick cost: chunk capture moved off the main thread and runs only for watched areas. In a 1,024-chunk unload storm, the worst added tick time fell from 700-880 ms to 49-121 ms. The server's chunk-summary rate cap now takes effect as well.
- Fabric servers now build map correction tiles off the server thread, so tile requests no longer put chunk reads and encoding onto the server tick.

## Fixes

- Fixed portal markers landing on the wrong dimension's map right after crossing a portal: the destination portal is now filed under its own dimension, and duplicates that had been registered under both dimensions are cleaned up the next time that portal is scanned. Already-affected markers heal once their chunk is scanned again.
- Fixed quadra-gen layout matching treating a datapack dimension as a vanilla dimension when only part of its name matched: a dimension like foo:overworld no longer gets the vanilla overworld's layout. Matching now compares the full dimension identity.
- The map's update-speed setting now really changes how fast the visible area is captured: previously every value captured at the same rate. The default of 8 keeps the previous behavior, and a high value can no longer push the game into very slow ticks.
- An error in another mod's code that ConfluxMap invokes no longer crashes the game: it is caught and logged, and the failing integration point stays disabled instead of repeating - this covers per-frame and per-block hooks, while one-off actions such as clicks and respawns still report every error. A broken reserved chat click also no longer leaks its internal payload to the clipboard.
- Waypoints 10 million blocks or more from the origin now use plain decimal coordinates: teleporting to them works again (the game rejects scientific notation like 1.0E7), and shared-waypoint lists in chat and waypoint search display and match the full digits instead of exponent text.
- The address advertised for the web map now reflects the configured bind address instead of always reporting a loopback URI; IPv6 addresses are formatted so the link opens correctly, and wildcard binds show a loopback address.
- Fixed radar head portraits getting stuck in a loading state or showing a previous world's data after switching worlds or servers: portrait decodes still in flight when the old world was cleared no longer publish their stale results.

---

## 改进

- 大半径的全屏生物群系搜索大幅提速：10 万格半径的搜索在 6 个工作线程下，常见群系约 0.7 秒、稀有群系约 0.3 秒即可完成，此前需要数秒（工作线程落到能效核心时更久）。搜索结果保持原有的地表群系语义。
- 打开生物群系视图的速度大幅提升：生物群系瓦片不再计算用不到的地形，第一个细节层级的单个瓦片从约 1.0 秒降到约 27 毫秒。山坡处的颜色现在可能反映气候群系而非地表群系，与 cubiomes-viewer 的语义一致。
- 当地图正在监视的区块大批卸载时，Paper 服务器不再出现大幅 tick 尖峰；保持地图打开也不再带来稳定的每 tick 开销：区块捕获已移出主线程，且只为被监视的区域运行。在 1024 个区块的卸载风暴测试中，最差的额外 tick 耗时从 700–880 毫秒降到 49–121 毫秒。服务端的区块摘要速率上限现在也会生效。
- Fabric 服务器现在在服务端线程之外构建地图修正瓦片，瓦片请求不再把区块读取和编码压到服务端 tick 上。

## 修复

- 修复了穿越传送门后传送门标记落到错误维度地图上的问题：目标传送门现在登记在其所属维度下，此前同时登记在两个维度下的重复标记会在该传送门下次被扫描时清除。已受影响的标记会在其区块再次被扫描后自动恢复。
- 修复了 quadra-gen 布局匹配在名称仅部分相同时把数据包维度当作原版维度的问题：类似 foo:overworld 的维度不再套用原版主世界的布局。匹配现在比较完整的维度标识。
- 地图的更新速度设置现在确实会影响可见区域的采集速度：此前不同取值的采集速率完全相同。默认值 8 保持原有行为，且过高的取值不再会把游戏拖入极慢的 tick。

...

releases.notes:
## Improvements

- Chunks whose blocks keep changing every tick, such as redstone contraptions, are no longer fully recaptured after every single update. Rapid updates now fold into one recapture per hold-off window, cutting full-chunk captures by about 89% in a redstone-flicker benchmark, with the final change still appearing one tick after the flicker stops. A new Live Recapture Interval slider in the performance settings (0–100 ticks, default 10; 0 restores the old behavior) controls the window.

## Fixes

- Cave and nether floor layers no longer show scattered plant dots from flowers, mushrooms, saplings, and lush-cave or nether plants, while torches, rails, snow, and moss carpets still render. The Conflux-style surface also stops drawing grass tufts, matching the already-synced map.
- The Xaero map style now also hides soul torches, redstone torches, and stained-glass overlays on the surface, matching what Xaero's own scan shows.

---

## 改进

- 方块每刻都在变化的区块（例如红石机械）不再在每次更新后都被完整重采。连续的更新会合并为每个等待窗口一次的重采；在红石闪烁基准测试中，完整区块重采次数减少约 89%，闪烁停止后最后一次变化仍会在 1 刻后显示。性能设置中新增“动态重采间隔”滑块（0–100 tick，默认 10；设为 0 恢复旧行为）用于控制该窗口。

## 修复

- 洞穴和下界底层不再显示由花朵、蘑菇、树苗以及繁茂洞穴或下界植物形成的杂色植物圆点；火把、铁轨、雪和苔藓地毯仍会正常显示。Conflux 风格的地表也不再绘制草丛，与已同步的地图保持一致。
- Xaero 地图风格的地表现在也会隐藏灵魂火把、红石火把和染色玻璃覆盖层，与 Xaero 自身扫描显示的内容一致。


**Full commit history:** [`v0.1.12...v0.1.13`](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/compare/v0.1.12...v0.1.13)

releases.notes:
## Improvements

- Added a five-level Map Quality slider for the fullscreen map, from Ultra Performance to Ultra Quality, controlling how the map switches detail levels while zooming. ([PR #117](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/117))
- Added the /confluxmap fullsync command, letting a server operator pull every generated region of the current dimension to their own client in one run, with progress shown in chat and /confluxmap fullsync cancel to stop it. It requires the new fullSyncEnabled server option, which is off by default. ([PR #117](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/117))
- Biome and structure searches gained a farthest-first ordering that lists the matches closest to the edge of the search radius first; farthest-first biome searches also take predicted, unexplored terrain into account. ([PR #118](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/118))
- New waypoint options: close the fullscreen map once a teleport is sent, choose the tab the waypoint list opens on (local or shared), and choose whether it lists the current dimension or all dimensions. The defaults match the previous behavior.
- Expanded the experimental API for integrators: read-only access to the shared-waypoint catalog with a change notification, an override for the tab and dimension filter the waypoint list opens with, a notification after fullscreen-map location actions, and a query through which an extension can supply the landing height for teleport targets the mod cannot resolve on its own.

## Fixes

- Waypoint beams and labels are no longer erased by deferred-rendering shader packs that rebuild the frame after the world pass, and they still appear at the correct position on screen.
- Biome and structure searches now run in the background instead of blocking the map view while they scan, and closing the candidate screen cancels a search that is still running. ([PR #118](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/118))
- Searches that exhaust their scan budget now warn that results may be incomplete and suggest narrowing the search radius, instead of presenting partially scanned results as complete. ([PR #118](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/118))

---

## 改进

- 新增五档地图画质滑块（超级性能、性能、平衡、质量、超级质量），控制全屏地图缩放时细节等级的切换方式。 ([PR #117](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/117))
- 新增 /confluxmap fullsync 命令：服务端管理员可将当前维度全部已生成区域一次性同步到自己的客户端，并在聊天栏查看进度，/confluxmap fullsync cancel 可随时中止。该功能由新的服务端配置 fullSyncEnabled 控制，默认关闭。 ([PR #117](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/117))
- 群系与结构查找新增“由远到近”排序，优先列出最靠近搜索半径边缘的匹配结果；“由远到近”的群系搜索也会纳入预测的未探索地形。 ([PR #118](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/118))
- 新增路径点选项：传送发出后关闭全屏地图、路径点列表打开时默认进入的标签页（本地/共享）、以及列表显示当前维度还是全部维度；默认值保持此前的行为。
- 扩展了实验性 API 供其他模组集成：只读访问共享路径点目录并在其变化时收到通知、覆盖路径点列表打开时的标签页与维度筛选、在全屏地图位置操作执行后收到通知，以及为模组自身无法确定落点的传送目标提供落地高度的查询。

## 修复

- 在世界渲染结束后重绘画面的延迟渲染光影包不再抹掉路径点光柱与标签，它们仍会显示在屏幕上的正确位置。
- 群系与结构查找现改为在后台运行，扫描期间不再阻塞地图视图；关闭候选界面会取消仍在进行的搜索。 ([PR #118](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/118))
- 搜索耗尽扫描预算时，现在会提示结果可能不完整并建议缩小搜索半径，而不再把只扫描了一部分的结果当作完整结果展示。 ([PR #118](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/118))


**Full commit history:** [`v0.1.11...v0.1.12`](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/compare/v0.1.11...v0.1.12)

releases.notes:
## Improvements

- Hovering a row in the structure and biome search candidate lists now shows a tooltip with the complete line - name, coordinates, and distance - whenever the row's text is clipped, drawn above the surrounding interface so nothing covers it. ([PR #116](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/116))

## Fixes

- Fixed map data cached for unloaded chunks on Paper servers being kept forever when a chunk unloaded without being written to disk, which caused constant file-time checks that consumed 27.7% of the main thread on a reported production server while pinning a growing number of summaries in memory. Pending entries are now rechecked once per second per region file and released no later than 30 seconds after unload.
- Fixed a ConcurrentModificationException logged every second on Paper servers when chunk unloads were pending in two or more regions at the same time.

---

## 改进

- 在结构和生物群系搜索的候选列表中悬停某一行时，只要该行文本被截断，就会显示包含完整内容（名称、坐标和距离）的提示框，并绘制在界面最上层，不会被其他元素遮挡。 ([PR #116](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/116))

## 修复

- 修复了 Paper 服务器上区块在无需写盘的情况下卸载时，为其缓存的地图数据可能被永久保留的问题：这会导致持续的文件时间检查，在一台有用户报告的生产服务器上占用 27.7% 的主线程时间，同时使越来越多的摘要驻留内存。现在这些待处理条目按区域文件每秒复查一次，最迟在卸载 30 秒后释放。
- 修复了 Paper 服务器上当两个或更多区域同时存在待处理的区块卸载时，每秒都会记录一次 ConcurrentModificationException 的问题。


**Full commit history:** [`v0.1.11-beta.1...v0.1.11`](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/compare/v0.1.11-beta.1...v0.1.11)

releases.notes:
## Improvements

- Added support for Minecraft 1.20.5 and 1.20.6.

## Fixes

- Fixed the tooltip of the waypoint editor's cross-dimension Y field chasing the pointer around the screen after the field was clicked; tooltips now only appear while the pointer is actually over the control. ([PR #113](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/113))
- Fixed, on Minecraft 1.18.2 and older, the search field keeping its focus border and blinking cursor after the location menu took over the keyboard, even though keystrokes then triggered the menu's digit shortcuts instead. ([PR #114](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/114))
- Fixed long tooltip text running off the screen edge: hints such as the portal icon-texture setting, long waypoint names, and resource-pack item display names now wrap onto multiple lines instead. ([PR #115](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/115))

---

## 改进

- 新增对 Minecraft 1.20.5 和 1.20.6 的支持。

## 修复

- 修复了路径点编辑器中跨维度 Y 字段被点击后，其提示框会一直跟随指针在屏幕上移动的问题；现在只有指针实际悬停在控件上时才会显示提示框。 ([PR #113](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/113))
- 修复了在 Minecraft 1.18.2 及更早版本中，位置菜单接管键盘输入后，搜索框仍显示聚焦边框和闪烁光标的问题（此时按键实际会触发菜单的数字快捷键）。 ([PR #114](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/114))
- 修复了过长的提示文本超出屏幕边缘的问题：传送门图标材质设置说明、过长的路径点名称以及资源包物品显示名等提示现在会自动折行为多行，不再超出窗口。 ([PR #115](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/pull/115))


**Full commit history:** [`v0.1.10...v0.1.11-beta.1`](https://github.com/Conflux-Union/conflux-map/compare/v0.1.10...v0.1.11-beta.1)
